title: Coupling Independence Implies Zero-Freeness
summary: For $Δ\ge2$ and $q\ge11Δ/6$, we prove that the antiferromagnetic $q$-state Potts partition function on finite simple graphs of maximum degree at most $Δ$ has no Fisher zeros in a graph-uniform complex neighbourhood of $[0,1]$. For $q>11Δ/6$, the proof establishes coupling independence throughout $[0,1]$ using a soft version of Vigoda's flip dynamics. Our main tool is a separator-shell transfer theorem for the Potts model on induced-subgraph closed classes of graphs of maximum degree at most $Δ$, with $q\geΔ+1$.
